title: I Closed the TIFU With the Microwave I Should Not Have Trusted

parts.text: I reheated fish in the office microwave and became a cautionary tale by 12:12. I am thirty-five, reluctant manager, hungry, dumb. The break room always smells like burnt coffee. I added ocean. My teammate Lila gagged, then laughed, then gagged. I opened windows that do not open. I bought a box fan from the drugstore, the cheap one that rattles. I sent a Slack: this was me, I am sorry, I will eat cold food until I die. HR did not need to be involved. HR still forwarded a smell policy as a joke. I followed it. I posted a $20 venmo for air freshener. People roasted me, fairly. The fish was leftover from a date that had gone fine, unlike lunch. I own the TIFU because owning it killed the hunt for a culprit. The rattling fan is still there. I bring salads. I am still hungry. The coffee smell eventually won again, which is how you know a workplace has healed. Lila said, "Is that fish" I said, "It was a mistake with rice" Lila taped a sign: NO SEA. I initialed it. I can still name the ugly little detail, which is how I know it happened.

social.video_title: I microwaved fish and bought the box fan myself
social.description: Burnt coffee lost to ocean for one horrible hour. I Venmo'd air freshener. Would you have confessed on Slack immediately?
